title: Mandalorian Helmets
description: Want sinister looking, edgy helmets for your army of sentries? Or maybe Mandalorian Style Helmets that work with vanilla trims? Well have I got a pack for you...
body:
Inspired by the helmet wearing Star Wars characters, this resource pack aims to emulate the mysterious tone that the Mandalorian have with their mask on.
It also works well for a Sentry style, if that's your cup of tea.
Whatever you might use it for, this Pack is perfect for edgy-looking Netherite gear.


This is the way.
